description: Read any smart contract function (eth_call) on Base, Ethereum and 5 more chains. Calls a view function by its signature, e.g. sig=balanceOf(address)&args=0x...&returns=uint256, on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, Optimism or Avalanche. Arguments: address, bool, bytes32, uintN, intN. Return types: those plus string and bytes (comma-separated for several static values). Returns raw hex and decoded values. Not cached. Price $0.001 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).

chain.description: One of ethereum, base, arbitrum, bsc, polygon, optimism, avalanche

returns.description: Comma-separated return types, e.g. uint256 or string
